description.subtitle: Football ball adidas of the Champions League 2025 2026 in size 5 - white, blue
description.intro: Adidas Football Ball of the Champions League 2025 2026 in size 5 - white, blue. The adidas Champions League Ball 25 26 Training size 5 is made to withstand the intensity of the day to day, allowing you to train with the same inspiration of the Champions League.
key_benefits: Iconic design: Official UEFA Champions League graphics with astronomical watch details and zodiac signs.
Optimized durability: Unstoppable machine stitched cover and a sturdy butyl chamber, making it perfect for use over and over again.
Reliable touch: Butyl chamber for prolonged air retention.
Versatilidad: Ideal para partidos, entrenamientos y uso recreativo.
European inspiration: The perfect ball to feel like a star.
